parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering me 1 Wood for 1 Ore. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Wood and 1 Ore. I already have an abundance of Wood and very little Ore. My production at Node 41 gives me Ore on 5s, but I only have 1 Ore in hand right now. More importantly, I need Ore to eventually build cities or buy development cards. Taking more Wood when I already have 3 is counter-productive, especially since I need Brick and Wheat to settle N23. Trading away my only Ore for a fourth Wood is a bad move strategically. I will reject this trade.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Gemma's Wood for Ore trade. I have 3 Wood and only 1 Ore; I need to keep the Ore for future cities/dev cards. Gemma is low on resources and desperate for Brick, which I also don't have. Waiting for a Wheat/Brick opportunity for N23.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'מה, אני באמת רוצה לעזור, אבל יש לי כבר ערימות של עץ ורק אבן אחת בכיס. אני לא יכול לוותר עליה עכשיו, זה פשוט יתקע אותי לגמרי.
